title: FairyCoinPack
description: Replaces gold, iron, and copper ingots, nuggets, and blocks with coins.
body:
Replaces gold, iron, and copper ingots, nuggets, and blocks with coins.

 

The resource pack reskins the sponge block to resemble a gacha machine. It contains models from the FairyCoin mod. To make the gacha machine functional, you can use the FairyCoin plugin.
